title: Writing Solid Responsive Search Ads | Gravitate

facts.fact: Each responsive search ad has room for up to 15 headlines and 4 descriptions.
facts.quote: Each responsive search ad has room for up to 15 headlines and 4 descriptions we can fill.

facts.fact: According to the page, 71% of consumers surveyed preferred ads tailored to their interests and shopping habits; the survey's source is not named on the page.
facts.quote: 71% of consumers surveyed preferred ads that are tailored to their interests and shopping habits.

facts.fact: The page states that Google announced extended text ads were being discontinued, in June 2022.
facts.quote: Google announced extended text ads were going the way of the dodo

facts.fact: The page states that Google chooses which responsive search ad combinations to serve based on a user's search history, past clicks, device type, and search query.
facts.quote: Google chooses which combinations to serve based on a user’s search history, past clicks, device type, and search query (keywords used).

facts.fact: The article was published on April 28, 2022.
